Nominations and self-referrals

challenge_text:
Challenge a suggestion or ask for a correction

Record only what the person supplied, including digital, phone, letter or in-person requests. A person owns the response. Nothing is sent here. Ask the named officer for accessible human help without using this screen. Urgent hazard response continues separately.

A challenge never means consent, refusal or a sanction. It does not close another request, change priority or delay safety work. A recorded human correction makes only suggestions and reviews that used that version need a fresh review. It does not change source information or policy automatically.

A challenge or correction never lowers your priority, eligibility or place in the queue.
It never records you as refusing or withdrawing, or changes your consent.
It never pauses, holds or extends the clock on any hazard or safeguarding response.

Assurance: Raising this challenge or correction will not be held against you. We have not recorded you as refusing, and no safety or hazard response has been paused or delayed.
